mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(statDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS regDate, NVL(dauCount, 0) AS cnt FROM DAILY_VISIT WHERE statDate BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY statDate

WITH date_range AS ( SELECT TRUNC(#{startDate}) + LEVEL - 1 AS dt FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= TRUNC(#{endDate}) - TRUNC(#{startDate}) + 1 ) SELECT TO_CHAR(d.dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS regDate, NVL(COUNT(m.memDate), 0) AS cnt FROM date_range d LEFT JOIN MEMBER m ON TRUNC(m.memDate) = d.dt GROUP BY d.dt ORDER BY d.dt
